activity_summary: At nine you pleaded a pain in the head. He asked where. You said behind the eyes, and that it was full of gnats. You left the fourth pint uncalled.

entities.name: Thomas Nashe
entities.context: Asked where, and let the fourth pint go.

facets.activity: Pleaded a pain in the head and went

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Behind the eyes. It's full of gnats.
